title: Philadelphia: Rug Tufting Workshop
blurb:
Craft your own custom rug in just one session and unleash your creativity! 
Our Rug Tufting Workshop is a fun, hands-on experience where you design and tuft a rug from scratch - no experience needed! Take home your masterpiece the same day, enjoy a cozy studio vibe, and make unforgettable memories in Philadelphia.
Perfect for solo travelers, couples, friends, and anyone looking for a unique DIY adventure!
